messages:
maya: Heads-up — found a privileged entrypoint in a canary image for runtime-shim. Need RBAC + KMS plan and audit trail before we promote. image sha: sha256:abcd1234efgh5678. Can we triage?
samir: Thanks. Which image tag and where was it built?
maya: tag: shim-canary-2026-03-20, built in registry prod-bakes. build link: https://artifacts.example/builds/12345
alex: Can you paste the Dockerfile snippet? quick check for USER root or any setuid bits.
maya: snippet: ```Dockerfile
FROM debian:bullseye
COPY shim /usr/local/bin/shim
ENTRYPOINT ["/usr/local/bin/shim"]
# note: shim drops to root unless SUID cleared
```
irene: If the entrypoint drops privileges that can be OK, but two immediate requirements: ensure image has no SUID/SGID files and emit attestation events to KMS/cosign on push. Who currently has the signer role for prod?
maya: @irene i think only 'build-service' has cosign signer in staging, not prod. @ops-bot can you emit current signer ACLs?
ops-bot: iam: build-service -> roles/cosignSigner
cloudkms: projects/prod/locations/global/keyRings/images/cryptoKeys/prod-key -> members: group:key_admins@redwood (no recent changes)
samir: We should rotate the signer so build-service can't sign prod images until RBAC is tightened. Proposal: create a short-lived signer role 'image-signer-canary' scoped to the canary registry and require 2 approvals for promotion to prod-signer. Thoughts?
alex: Agree. Also add a runtime verification/audit hook: when container starts emit an 'image-sig-verified' audit log with fields: image, signer, key-id, sig-time. Hook should block start if verification fails. We can add as a container runtime hook.
maya: Immediate mitigation idea: rebuild removing any setuid bits + build with a non-root USER in Dockerfile + add cosign verification in the entrypoint script. That should buy time.
irene: Policy-wise I will open an RBAC ticket to remove build-service from prod signer and add a keystore-auditors group with read-only KMS logging access. @samir can you prepare the rotation playbook?
samir: On it. Playbook will include commands and checks, e.g.:
```
# sign image with KMS-backed key
cosign sign --key gcpkms://projects/prod/locations/global/keyRings/images/cryptoKeys/prod-key
  gcr.io/redwood/shim-canary-2026-03-20
# verify role
gcloud iam roles describe roles/cosignSigner
```
maya: I ran cosign verify locally and saw signer info:
```
Verified OK : sha256:abcd1234efgh5678
Signed by: build-service@redwood
KeyVersion: projects/prod/locations/global/keyRings/images/cryptoKeys/prod-key/cryptoKeyVersions/3
```
alex: Good find. Next steps: short-term denylist that exact digest from auto-promotion, run canary with enhanced instrumentation, and add audit forwarder to the security project so KMS sign/verify events are retained. I'll coordinate with SRE for the denylist.
ops-bot: denylist updated: added sha256:abcd1234efgh5678 to image-promotion-denylist (expires in 72h)
maya: Thanks. Can we schedule a quick incident sync to align roles and timeline? 15 minutes should do it.
irene: I can do 11:30 PT.
samir: 11:30 PT works for me — I'll DM the meeting link.
maya: :thumbsup: prepping checklist: 1) rebuild with USER nobody, 2) run cosign sign with rotated key, 3) update runtime hook to verify & emit audit, 4) file RBAC ticket to remove prod signer from build-service.
alex: I'll add runtime tracing and a metric image_verification_failure to alert if verification fails in canary.
maya: Closing loop after the meeting — will update this thread with action items and timelines.
